observations: Photo 0 shows a black Xbox console with visible scratches and wear on the front panel. The 'XBOX' logo is visible on the lower left.
Photo 1 shows the front of the console, with the same scratches and wear. The top left corner has the 'XBOX' logo.
Photo 2 shows the back of the console with a label that includes 'XBOX ONE CONSOLE', 'MODEL: 12000543', and other specifications. The label is slightly worn and has some smudges.
All photos have a watermark 'POSTED ON JI ODIKA UZOR'.

claims.claim: Fairly used Xbox One in very good condition
claims.evidence: Photos show visible scratches and wear, but no functional test or internal inspection is shown. The condition cannot be confirmed as 'very good' without proof of operation and internal state.
No screen or interface is shown to verify installed games. The console's screen is not visible in any photo.
Controllers and power pack are not shown in any photo. The seller states they are needed, but no proof is provided.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, displaying the home screen, and running a game.

risks.risk: Games may not be installed or may be corrupted
risks.proof: A screenshot or video showing the installed games list on the console's home screen.

risks.risk: Controllers and power pack may be missing or damaged
risks.proof: Photos of the controllers and power pack, showing they are present and functional.

risks.risk: Console may have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, HDMI, cooling system)
risks.proof: A video showing the console playing a disc and connecting to a TV via HDMI.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and running a game.
Screenshot or video of the installed games list.
Photos of the controllers and power pack.
Video showing the console playing a disc and connecting to a TV.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
